depends_on: prime number theorem: prime in (x, (1+eps)x] for x >= x0(eps)
notes: Write-up in OEIS/A131194. Every seed's orbit merges with the main one (share >= 3 and share >= 2 digits). Proof: blocks of D-digit numbers with fixed top 8 digits each contain a prime for large D (PNT); orbits walk every prime of a block and leave it at its largest prime; top parts x9^r with len(x) >= 4 pass to the next block; bad blocks (r >= 5) jump at most 1000 blocks over only good blocks, so every orbit falls into the main one. Outside Lean: the whole argument, with PNT in short-interval form as input. Seeds below 1e4 checked by script.
